prompt: Make a character turnaround sheet for building a 3D game model of the young woman in the reference image: the same face, sun-browned skin, dark hair and colours, rendered in the same stylised 3D look with soft hand-painted texture on solid, rounded forms. Do not copy the reference's pose, wall or camera. Four full-body views of this one character standing side by side in a row, left to right: (1) front view, facing the viewer; (2) left side view, a strict profile showing her left side, her nose pointing at the left edge of the image; (3) back view, facing away from the viewer; (4) right side view, a strict profile showing her right side, her nose pointing at the right edge of the image. Same height and scale in every view, head to toe fully visible, generous empty space between the views, nothing overlapping or cut off. Straight-on, orthographic-looking camera at mid-body height, even soft studio lighting with no cast shadows, plain flat light grey background. Her design: about twenty, an apprentice sluice-keeper, with stylised but natural human proportions; dark hair pulled into a tight low bun at the nape with no loose strands; a close-fitting sleeveless tunic in deep teal that stays fitted to the body all the way down and ends at the hip with no flare and no skirt; a flat brown leather belt at the waist with one small brown leather pouch fixed flat on her right hip, so the pouch shows on the image's left in the front view, on the image's right in the back view, faces the viewer in the right side view and is hidden in the left side view; fitted dark-brown trousers bound at the shins with pale cloth bands; soft brown leather climbing shoes; brown leather wraps on both wrists. Nothing loose: no cape, hood, scarf, sash, hanging straps, satchel or bag on the back. Nothing held. No text, no labels, no numbers, no arrows, no ground line, no shadow under the feet.
